This report therefore does **not** give unconditional final-candidate approval, global C05 acceptance or owner acceptance.

I read source bodies needed to compare each assigned authored premise, affirmative result, qualification, currentness statement and evidence interpretation. The owner’s 18 October amendment permits support grouped under its authoritative work/collection owner. Derived result-title routes received exhaustive identity reconciliation and targeted body checks at mathematical risk points. That is deliberately narrower than re-proving every indexed theorem.

No old author-curation record or unseen independent-review assertion is credited as my fresh independent acceptance. Where I read an existing bounded review body, its documented claim is historical scoped evidence. Newly checked unchanged sources may be reused within the exact recorded scope; the published hash readback establishes continuity, not broader comprehension.

# Independent scholarly AI review: learning, repair and finite histories

## Candidate and disposition

Reviewed published candidate: `515fbeb835683ffebd0b15ef5eab67f368a89f7d`; tree `8926ce39d0f087de459c6aca16d26f430a7f7038`; parent `94947c4729b39ce4c785b61af7191f23f437c04b`. The commit and tree were independently inspected in the shared repository. Publication and the in-progress hosted CI run `39104139767` were reported by the coordinating maintainer; this review does not certify CI.

The source-comparison pass is complete for **46 authored catalogue summaries**, their related assertions in the other five reader pages, and their authoritative crosswalk bindings. Twelve substantive findings were repaired by the maintainer and independently read back in this exact candidate. **Two minor wording changes remain open**, specified below. A subsequent repaired delta must be separately read back before this report is carried forward as final for that delta.

This is a separately acting AI/model scholarly review, not an external human peer review or owner acceptance. The reviewer did not implement the shared-repository changes. No merge, release, issue closure or C06 decision is supplied. The five prepared independent-reader tasks were neither read from answer keys nor executed by this reviewer.

## Review population and method

The population is substantive scholarship, not every retained research receipt. Coverage comprises 15 critical-repair/actual-law learning summaries, 15 prior/width/inference summaries, six Seventh technical summaries, six Eighth operational-history summaries, and four Ninth certificate/execution/transport summaries. Every authored synopsis in these sections was compared against its cited claim-bearing source sections and material assumptions and limitations. Related authored propositions in all five other reader pages were checked against the same sources. Derived identifier/title routes were checked against the original result owners and catalogue anchors.

The source ledger records **164 distinct bound source objects** plus **six followed formal dependencies**. Reading depth is explicit per object: complete primary mathematical and source-review Markdown bodies where recorded; formal definitions and theorem signatures for bound Lean interfaces; the complete 279-line rational Python reference; bounded evaluator-domain/runtime sections for the pinned expression implementation; and the specifically relevant metadata fields for retained receipt/registry status. The Eighth 492-line shared guide was read at its overview, every exact-model/claim/evidence paragraph and all assumptions/limits blocks, not claimed as an undifferentiated full body read. All 164 source bindings and the six followed dependencies were hash-checked against the published Git objects. The six reader pages and crosswalk also have exact SHA-256 bindings in the ledger.

The pass tested quantifiers, premises, finite versus asymptotic claims, all-time versus eventual guarantees, prior and endpoint conditions, exact versus approximate or executable conclusions, formal versus ordinary scope, empirical overclaim, source/section identity and relevant dated standing. It did not re-prove every theorem, compile Lean, replay scientific scripts, authenticate a physical source service, reacquire external papers, or catalogue historical support files as separate scholarly works.

## Open follow-up wording

1. **Eighth effect scope — `PAPER-CATALOGUE.md:558`.** Replace “the first 20 trials effect-free” with wording that explicitly says the first 20 trials leave the **Plant** unchanged. Their root memories change. The existing “one admissible world” qualification is correct. This is a propagation of ILR-11’s effect-field distinction, not a new lower-bound or universal-world claim.

2. **Stale navigation — `CURRENT-FRONTIERS.md:165`.** Remove “forthcoming” from “The forthcoming successor entries”; the Eighth/Ninth successor entries are already present.

The maintainer acknowledged both for the follow-up qualification delta. Neither may be recorded as repaired solely on that acknowledgement. ## Cross-page and relationship conclusions

The added Seventh/Eighth/Ninth paragraphs in the atlas, result index, verification guide, frontiers and applications preserve the distinctions established by the sources: rule installation versus separately granted draft repair; distinct actual roots versus labels; cancellation responses versus accumulated durable memories; structural alignment versus authentic policy; monotone numerical annotations versus authentic clock service; literal shared-state obstruction versus one-way simulation; protected logical schedules versus physical or asynchronous deadlines; accepted finite evidence versus an extracted controller; and faithful reconstruction versus legal admission. Whole-history transport consistently transforms complete command keys and remains separate from in-place authority.

The learning paragraphs preserve source-dependent expected score versus literal per-report correctness, all-time abstaining safety versus eventual always-issued correction, fixed-parameter finite expectation versus prior-integrated expectation, almost-sure finiteness versus finite mean, positive-time versus zero-receipt charging, countable versus finite model populations, and shape/width/contamination hypotheses. Measurable policy existence is not recast as an exact-real executable optimizer. Formal component evidence is not promoted into formal proof of ordinary continuous-mixture or analytic arguments.

The focused source-comparison and placement review is complete for the scope recorded here. **No unresolved consequential philosophical claim-fidelity finding remains in the reviewed published prose.** P-01 and P-02 are resolved in the exact published candidate. **P-03 remains an editorial currentness finding in that candidate**; the parent reports corrections in its unpublished delta, which require a later exact published readback. This report is therefore not unconditional acceptance of a later commit or of the whole candidate across other reviewers’ domains.

The bound input is commit `515fbeb835683ffebd0b15ef5eab67f368a89f7d`, tree `8926ce39d0f087de459c6aca16d26f430a7f7038`, at `/tmp/orthemology-reader-515`. ### P-02 — resolved in published 515

The earlier shorthand “lower-link limitations” risked locating the lunar-event problem at the link whose positive support had been established. # C05 independent engineering and catalogue-identity review

Reviewer: separate AI/model session `/root/independent_technical_review`, independent of the implementation authors. This is not external human peer review. All review writes remained in `/tmp/orthemology_independent_technical/`; the shared repository was read-only for this reviewer.

## Disposition and exact scope

**The original published 515 candidate was not acceptable as a final candidate:** 105 catalogue work routes lacked a usable route from the assigned family to the actual work body; two `fuller-original-of-condensed-reading` relation edges were reversed against their own source-selection owner; hosted CI 39104139767 failed at the existing math-source gate on two new unsupported notation commands. These findings remain recorded as failures of that candidate.

**The declared working repairs reviewed so far resolve the work-route and relation-direction findings.** All 448 work entries now reach their own actual primary/read-form identity, either directly or through an explicitly linked direct-note lookup. No remaining engineering or source-fidelity blocker has been found within this assigned scope. Final qualification still requires binding the completed delta to its actual published SHA/tree and a successful complete CI run. A working-tree readback is not a final published-candidate approval.

Scientific baseline: `0784acddd4770f1190f758f264ba52b2b110bd27`. Reviewed published candidate: `515fbeb835683ffebd0b15ef5eab67f368a89f7d`; tree: `8926ce39d0f087de459c6aca16d26f430a7f7038`. The frozen snapshot is `/tmp/orthemology-reader-515`. The declaration of later edits is restricted to reader/currentness/notation fixes, exact relationship corrections and review evidence preparation; no scientific source or validator change is qualified implicitly.

This review covers the full baseline change set and preservation boundary, checker/data integration, actual per-work catalogue identity, maintenance evidence, and the assigned native-v5/T18/main-exposition/formal-reference source comparisons. It does not assert that this reviewer has independently re-read or re-proved every underlying manuscript, historical support body, or external primary book. The five unassisted comprehension tasks and broader mathematical/philosophical source reviews belong to separately assigned reviewers. Their answers, comprehension keys and PILOT-QUALIFICATION were not inspected here.

## Source and protection preservation

The baseline contains 16,077 tracked objects; 515 contains 16,102. The change set has 33 paths: eight modifications to existing admitted refactor owners and 25 additions. There are no deletions. All **16,069 existing objects outside the exact reader-edit owners have identical Git blobs and file modes**. This is a comparison of the complete trees, not a sample based on paper extensions or familiar directories.

The authored block of `docs/current-state.yaml` is identical. Only the derived source digest and tracked-file count changed. The scientific result/status owners, source-store bodies, mathematical and executable sources, publication source components, governed PDFs, normative registries and dependency locks remain preserved at this baseline boundary.

The large T20 public-projection manifest has exactly two changes: explicit historical revision and blob coordinates were added for the already-published CONTRIBUTING and historical-status-index objects. I independently resolved both at revision `7efc6217c090b92d65f2c4cb8b011c18eb96bf7c`, checked their Git blobs, SHA-256 identities and byte counts, and compared the complete manifest after those two additions. No object selection, source/public identity, byte count or disposition changed. This preserves the old source identities while allowing the current reader owners to be edited.

The existing CI workflow is byte-identical after removing the exact seven-line reader-check addition. No pre-existing step, validator, permission, toolchain pin or gate was removed or relaxed. The new step adds census and reader-unit runs normally and under `-O`, followed by the production reader checker. The census source and all ten census tests were read: enumeration is pinned to a complete commit ID, uses NUL-delimited Git entries, preserves modes/gitlinks and unusual names, distinguishes duplicate blob identities from work counts, and does not follow bibliographic URLs or symlink targets.

Evidence: `preservation.json`. The preserved-tree count is an identity finding, not an assertion that 16,069 scientific bodies were semantically read.

## Compact ownership and causal controls

The checker and reader-test bytes at 515 exactly equal the independently repaired C04 patch. Their SHA-256 values are respectively `bd5ac31409970f4decf02db1d1ddf14bfa57dd28c3c8cf7ca6de1863b4f7306b` and `3711c629ccb0565de6ee73bd1e6a0a5000bdf94e13eed23bce4199d27c19c09a`. The earlier independent boundary evidence therefore remains applicable without repeating it.

The first compact patch admitted valid-looking but unrelated work/source identities. Independent mutations demonstrated primary-to-unrelated-work, primary-to-support-only-role, residual-to-unrelated-work and basis-to-unrelated-source false passes. The repaired implementation rejects those substitutions. Required primary, reading-form and independently required paths must remain explicit, and their work destination must actually bind that path. A valid owner fallback cannot hide an invalid present work destination or waive a mandatory primary item.

Compact residuals may use actual existing collection owners without artificially attaching repository tooling to an unrelated manuscript. Each basis source must be a declared group owner; each present residual owner/work list is validated; a work destination must bind an actual primary/read-form/supporting source inside the group's frozen population. The two exhaustive historical records retain their strict full-population semantics.

Fresh independent evidence retained from the bounded reviews includes:

- Eight initially added tests against the old checker: 17 assertion failures, zero errors.
- Four verified guard-removal mutations, all detected at their intended boundaries: primary omission, candidate all-group coverage, catalogue anchor existence and complete legacy population coverage. Restoring the implementation passed all four controls.
- The repaired compact tests against the first-patch implementation: 15 tests, 29 assertion failures, zero errors.
- The repaired focused classes: 81/81 passes normally and 81/81 under `-O`, plus independently reconstructed adverse ownership mutations that now reject as intended.

The initial failed attempt under a runtime lacking `markdown_it` supplies no control evidence. The successful independent replays used `/tmp/orthemology-issue35-venv/bin/python`, Python 3.12.14 with the task dependencies. The earlier reports and raw logs preserve the distinction between assertion-based causal rejection and import/runtime errors.

Malformed outer inputs such as `sources=[]` can still produce an inherited uncaught `AttributeError`. This is a fail-closed diagnostic limitation, not a newly observed false acceptance. Newly introduced compact destination shapes were independently tested, including valid fallback mixed with invalid explicit fields. No source/protection/status bypass remains in the reviewed repair.

## Integrated owner and relationship data

The integrated data contains 448 works, 1,620 source bindings and 26 groups. All 26 declared groups are required and dispositioned; 24 use compact records. The 119-path v5-consolidation and 1,200-path v5-continuations records are structurally identical to their complete records at 94947c4. Their completeness checks were not weakened.

The v5-successors result owner is the existing string path `docs/provenance/v5-successors/RESULT_STATUS.json`, rather than an imported report object. Its 262 exact result IDs equal the complete result-route key set, and every routed work retains the actual routed ID in its work record. The eight source-study relation origins equal all eight real primary source keys of the appraisal work; their destinations and basis resolve to the original reading guide/index. All relation endpoints and bases resolve to source keys.

Source-key validity alone did not make the two T08 relationships correct. `CURRENT_SELECTION.md` states that `9cec919…/ARGUMENT.md` is the complete original and `40fe0b…/ARGUMENT.md` its condensed reader; likewise `e22ffbc…/SOURCE_INTEGRITY_ARGUMENT.md` is the original and `e4cff3…/SOURCE_INTEGRITY_ARGUMENT.md` its condensed reader. 515 had both arrows backwards under the `fuller-original-of-condensed-reading` label. The corrected working delta now points original→condensed for each pair, with the same source basis. The catalogue links already identified the originals correctly, and the neutral retained-projection reading-form labels did not require alteration.

Evidence: `owner-relation-review.json`, retaining the original failures and later readback separately.

## All 448 catalogue-entry identities and actual routes

The generic checker establishes anchor existence. This review separately binds the selected section or table row to the actual primary/read-form identity. It resolves Markdown reference links, literal HTML anchors at their true source line, the appropriate table row rather than a neighboring row, and explicit grouped paths through the result index. All 588 primary work bindings (566 distinct source paths) were read back against their actual byte hashes. Source titles, headers, structured roles and component identities were compared with the corresponding work identities. All 183 source-fragment targets were resolved to the intended named source headings, including separately identified chapters in the Fifteenth and Sixteenth compendia.

| Candidate state | Direct work route | Explicit grouped work route | Missing work route |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Original 515 | 334 | 9 | 105 |
| Reviewed working route delta | 339 | 109 | 0 |

The repairs add the existing direct-note lookup to the proper-function, later-reissue and six-lane families, reaching 60, 14 and 26 previously stranded works respectively. The five newly direct work records are the communication programme, the retained BL–BU report, the T299 specification-defect study and the two challenger packets. # Independent philosophical/currentness working-delta review

Reviewer: `/root/independent_philosophy_review`, a separate AI/model reviewer, not the author or an external human peer reviewer.

## Disposition and binding

**Accept this bounded philosophical/currentness working delta. P-03 is locally repaired; no new unresolved philosophical finding was identified.** Exact published SHA/tree and successful full hosted CI remain pending for the final binding. This is not global C05 acceptance, C06 owner acceptance, merge authority or scientific adoption.

Baseline: `515fbeb835683ffebd0b15ef5eab67f368a89f7d`, tree `8926ce39d0f087de459c6aca16d26f430a7f7038`. The main worktree's committed HEAD/tree still have those identities. The reviewed changes are working-file bytes, bound individually in `WORKING-DELTA-BINDING.json` with their exact changed line ranges and combined diff hash. Two principal working hashes are:

| File | SHA256 |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/reader/PAPER-CATALOGUE.md` | `1c0842ffe75b150e590568da512923f57a77385ff3b708bdf7c5e40b356971b7` |
| `docs/reader/VERIFICATION-GUIDE.md` | `31b947e4b0c2f9a00258e323093558a55deddf72d5104f0038ad23f868823da2` |

All four immutable 515 report/binding files retain their recorded hashes. Their actual source-reading ledger, bounded historical-review reuse and guide-tail mismatch disposition remain unchanged; this addendum does not enlarge that scope or erase findings open on 515.

## Actual scope

I read every changed prose hunk in the six reader pages and README against 515. I also compared CROSSWALK structurally at every changed leaf: 448 review-status clauses, the endpoints of two corrected relationships, and two journey/curation fields. Source records and all other work fields are identical. This is complete delta scrutiny, not another complete reading of every page, scientific manuscript or repetitive raw status row.

Fourteen relevant source files match their 515 bytes; all applicable prior source-read hashes match the immutable ledger. A tracked-path diff over manuscript, formal, theory, research, experiments, applications and artifacts returned no changes. Only two small additional source comparisons were needed: `groups/foundations-t07-t15/CURRENT_SELECTION.md` lines 20–48 for the relationship declarations, and the complete 45-line `research-v6/root_math/calibrated_prose/REPORT.md` for its newly added navigation sentence. Full paths, hashes and actual ranges are in the binding. The reconciliation report's own claims to reading underlying reports are not adopted as reading by me.

## Findings and repairs

| Item | Bounded readback |
| --- | --- |
| **P-03 currentness** | Catalogue line 1027 and Frontiers lines 85, 95, 121, 123 and 165 now route existing scholarly coverage instead of describing it as future or unreconciled work. Atlas line 142, Applications line 183, Result Index line 290 and README line 34 consistently distinguish navigation coverage, actual source-reading scope and scientific standing. Grouped supporting records are not promoted into separate research articles. **Resolved for these working bytes.** |
| **P-01 and P-02** | The previously repaired common-source and rational-basing/attestation paragraphs are literally unchanged, now at catalogue lines 709 and 717. Their positive conditional appraisals, actual premises, remaining objection/informant limits and attribution distinctions remain intact. |
| **CP23** | Its paragraph is literally unchanged, now at line 689. The full single-token acquisition/every-additional-evidence contract and restricted-menu qualification remain explicit. |
| **Five communication programmes** | The new paragraph accurately distinguishes supplied scoped results from remaining source, interpretation, implementation and world-evidence burdens. Receipt, selected meaning, identity and action warrant remain distinct. It matches all five primary texts already read completely; all five hashes are unchanged. |

### Unassisted record 03 — completed comprehension of Tasks 1, 2 and 4

All statements below are my answers after reading the independently selected source excerpts. Please archive this record verbatim before any adjudication material is supplied.

#### Task 1 — finite-mediator claim, argument and construction

The originating work is **“A bounded information consequence for coordination explanations”**, specifically **section 5, “Exact finite-alphabet capture capacity.”** The Twelfth collection registers this as `T12-FINITE-MEDIATOR`; its related information-growth result in sections 1–4 is another result from the same work.

Fix one horizon, \(n>0\), \(S\sim N(0,n)\) under an ordinary joint law, an interval \(I\) of length \(L\geq0\), and a mediator \(M\) with at most \(N\geq1\) values. The essential completeness premise is \(Y\perp S\mid M\). Then
\[
P(Y+S\in I)\leq 2\Phi\!\left(\frac{NL}{2\sqrt n}\right)-1.
\]

**Upper-bound proof:** Section 5 defines \(\lambda_m(B)=P(M=m,S\in B)\), whose sum is the Gaussian law, and the conditional law \(\nu_m\) of \(Y\). Conditional independence bounds capture by \(\sum_m\sup_y\lambda_m(I-y)\). Choose finitely many almost-maximizing translates, allowing an \(\varepsilon/N\) error per label. Their union has length at most \(NL\), and their total submeasure mass is bounded by the Gaussian mass of that union. A centered interval maximizes centered-Gaussian mass at a fixed Lebesgue length; letting \(\varepsilon\) decrease to zero proves the formula. Nonatomicity handles endpoint conventions and \(L=0\). The argument does not assume each translation supremum is attained.

**Matching construction:** Partition the centered length-\(NL\) interval into \(N\) consecutive length-\(L\) cells. Let \(M\) encode the cell containing \(S\), assigning all exterior values to label 1. Set \(Y=y_M\), where \(y_m\) translates cell \(m\) onto \(I\). Because \(Y\) is constant given \(M\), conditional independence holds. Capture is exactly the centered interval up to null endpoints; outside values assigned to label 1 add no capture.

**Rejected stronger interpretation:** This is a retrospective, single-horizon optimum over encoder and state marginal. It does not establish a forward-causal physical coordinator, preserve an arbitrary prescribed marginal or terminal law, or provide one coherent history at every horizon. A finite program description is not automatically a complete mediator. The Twelfth owner classifies the papers as ordinary written mathematics and model-assisted checks, with no new Lean or whole-result kernel status.

**Actual route:** `README.md` → `RESULT-INDEX.md#finite-mediator` → the linked `BOUNDED_COORDINATION_INFORMATION_v1.md`, section 5. Two document transitions reach the proof. A separate two-transition route reaches `groups/t12-written/README.md` for the registered statement and evidence scope. Target identity matched the index and source title. No hash search or author route hint was used.

#### Task 2 — recognition, sound cognition, correction and limits

The **Sound Reason** source distinguishes immediate basic cognition from discursive clarification or reminder. A person can have warranted cognition without first possessing an endlessly prior proof of the reliability of every faculty. Its externalist proper-function account requires truth-directed faculties functioning appropriately in a suitable environment, with a high objective probability of true output under those conditions. Inferential reasoning can clarify assumptions and remove obstructions; it is a constructive corrective route within that account.

The **Concrete and Sound Reason** note separates whether cognition is concretely instantiated from whether it is epistemically successful. Faculty condition, premises, governing standard, case-bound configuration, execution, validity, result and truth linkage are distinct bearers or assessment dimensions. Its claim-relative strict soundness requires both an adequate relevant reasoning pathway and truth linkage. A procedurally adequate rare miss and an accidentally correct defective process therefore remain distinguishable.

**Tawātur’s broader role:** Sound Reason §4.2 treats widespread, diverse, non-collusive concordance of rational and fiṭrī deliverances as evidence about normal cognitive functioning itself, not merely the number of transmitted reports. That is the source’s positive cognitive-vindication thesis. Its asserted pan-human universality has not become a newly verified empirical survey merely by appearing in this repository. The concrete/sound note separately explains why copying, graph degree, popularity and institutional persistence cannot supply the required independence or warrant.

**Premise and positive foundational route:** The retained-passage report §2 presents a productive-adequacy argument whose target is an entire field with existence and productive actuality wholly received. Its premise is stronger than a generic prohibition on infinite regress: collecting received members does not by itself supply an unreceived productive basis, even without a first temporal member. The same section allows cooperation to make participants more effective together, so this is not an inference from individually weak parts to a necessarily weak whole. It also distinguishes the bare conclusion “Necessary Being” from the further identification of the actual Creator.

**Concrete source-supported rejection of a stronger interpretation:** The report’s Intisar 44–49 discussion expressly preserves ordinary knowledge without a universal prior proof while admitting mistakes and their particular causes. Consequently, positive basic recognition does not certify every particular exercise as infallible. The report also rejects the claim that everyone’s recognition must wait for the particular anti-regress proof. Separately, CR-6 and CR-9 in the concrete/sound note explain how several apparent corroborators can copy or share one upstream source, excluding “many agreeing voices automatically give independent warrant.”

**Scope distinction:** The concrete/sound note labels its own architectural assertions school-neutral, its Taymiyyan doctrinal connections secondary reconstruction, and its project mappings orthemological extensions. The tradition’s theological affirmations retain their own school-internal voice and premises. A formal typing scheme or engineering fixture neither authenticates a classical passage nor proves a creed. Conversely, these scope restrictions do not erase the source-bound positive recognition and foundational appraisals that the retained report expressly preserves.

**Actual route:** `README.md` → `RESEARCH-ATLAS.md#recognition-sound-cognition-and-correction` → Sound Reason §§1.1, 2, 4.2 and 5; parallel links from the same atlas section reach `CONCRETE-AND-SOUND-REASON.md` and `retained_passage40/REPORT.md`. #### Task 4 — a tensor question and its actual frontier

I selected the tensor route. **“Square positivity forces exact dynamics for every coercive polynomial,” Theorem G**, already supplies the representability bridge that the predecessor left restricted.

Its objects are real linear polynomial-moment functionals on a finite-dimensional numerical vector, equivalently full symmetric tensor moments; they are not arbitrary noncommutative tensors or a metaphorical tensor representation of a mind. With coercive real polynomial \(h\), normalized functionals \(L_t\), coordinatewise \(C^1\) regularity including continuous right derivatives at zero, positivity \(L_t(q^2)\geq0\) for **every** real polynomial \(q\), and the complete hierarchy
\[
L'_t(p)=-L_t(hp)+L_t(h)L_t(p),
\]
the written theorem gives exactly one probability law \(\mu\), with all absolute polynomial moments finite, representing that **complete path** by exponentially damped and normalized moments. Positive-time full moment records are determinate and the path extends uniquely.

The uniqueness is for a supplied complete path. A fixed initial moment record may have several representing laws and therefore several admissible paths. Initial representability follows from the full path hypotheses; it is not silently assumed. The successor removes the predecessor’s quadratic/SOS restriction for coercive \(h\); an unqualified claim that general coercive representability is still merely proposed would be outdated relative to these two supplied sources.

**Genuinely remaining application question:** How can a finite observed or truncated record justify, approximate or replace the full path hypotheses needed for a specified application? To advance it, one would need an explicit finite observation/approximation contract and a proof controlling the resulting error under independently justified tail, growth or regularity conditions—or a counterexample showing that the selected finite conditions do not control the claimed observable. Claiming that finitely many positive-semidefinite checks already establish every polynomial-square inequality would not do so. For an application to cognition, the variables, measurements and damping dynamics also need independent operational justification and evidence; the theorem alone supplies no empirical identification.

The frontiers page correctly separates this application problem from the already supplied coercive bridge. Its Fisher section gives another explicit boundary: preserving posterior answers, approximating geometry, and preserving exact ambient norms are different tasks; a fixed-fibre exact result does not prove a globally continuous minimal chart through changing-rank strata.
